text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon dazzles the crowd with a 
commanding performance. The spectators' 
anticipation swells for her showdown with 
the "Monster" who conquered two legs of 
the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the post-race press conference, Hishi 
Amazon lays down a challenge, declaring 
she wants to settle things one-on-one with 
Narita Brian at the next Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching the broadcast, Narita Brian 
smirked fearlessly to herself—
